description: This file defines models and logic for employee attendance tracking in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including classes for attendance records, employee status, and action reasons.

classes.name: hr_action_reason
classes.description: Model representing reasons for employee actions such as sign in or sign out.

classes.name: hr_attendance
classes.description: Model representing attendance records with sign in/out actions and constraints.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extension of hr.employee with attendance status and sign in/out methods.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: _state
methods.description: Computes the attendance state ('present' or 'absent') for employees based on latest attendance record.

methods.name: sign_change
methods.description: Signs in or out an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: sign_out
methods.description: Signs out an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: sign_in
methods.description: Signs in an employee at a specified date.

methods.name: _action_check
methods.description: Checks if the new attendance action has a valid date after the last recorded action.

methods.name: _altern_si_so
methods.description: Ensures sign-in/sign-out actions follow the correct sequence.
